source: For autoregressive decode, each sequence typically contributes one new token per decode step. Without batching many requests, an individual expert can receive very few tokens at a time, making expert GEMMs small and inefficient. Large serving batches can improve arithmetic intensity but also make routing/load patterns more important.
zh: 对于自回归解码，每个序列通常为每个解码步骤贡献一个新标记。如果不批量处理许多请求，单个专家一次只能收到很少的代币，从而使专家 GEMM 变得很小且效率低下。大批量服务可以提高算术强度，但也使路由/负载模式变得更加重要。
